messages.author: 26eb2199c8de6ecd
messages.subject: Erro
parts:
My dears,


I'm doing analysis with different epochs in GGIR with gt3x+ accelerometer. In the analyzes with epochs of 1s, 5s, 10s, 15s and 30s I can run all the participants without any problem. However, when I try to do it with the 60s epoch, some error messages appear and I can't get the results for some individuals.
I wish you could help me with this problem.

 

g.shell.GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),                              
  datadir="D:/Andrew/Dados Acelerometria Censo de saúde/Formato CSV para o           GGIR/60s", 
  outputdir="D:/Andrew/Dados Acelerometria Censo de saúde/Resultados do     GGIR/Resultados epoch 60ss",    
  do.report=c(2,4,5),                             
  overwrite = FALSE,                              
  windowsizes = c(60,900,3600),
  #=====================
  # Part 2              
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,                                   
  hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,    
  maxdur = 7,                 includedaycrit = 10,
  qwindow=c(0,24),                                
  mvpathreshold =c(100),                          
  bout.metric = 6,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE,
  epochvalues2csv = TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4          
  #=====================
  outliers.only = FALSE,               
  ignorenonwear = TRUE,                
  sensor.location= "wrist",            
  do.visual = TRUE,                    
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400), # Pontos de corte
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
 
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("MM"),
  visualreport=TRUE)

 

 

This is the error that appears at the end of the part 5 process

 

Errors and warnings for 1206023-24 (2023-03-31)RAW.csv.RData$message

[1] "missing value where TRUE/FALSE required"

 

$call if (nightsi[1] == 1) wi = wi + 1 Errors and warnings for 1252231-22 (2023-06-12)RAW.csv.RData$message

[1] "NA/NaN argument" $call nightsi[1]:dummywake

 

Errors and warnings for 2939376-02 (2022-09-08)RAW.csv$message
[1] "Opened 1.498GB (1608072683 bytes) file ok but could not memory map it. This is a 64bit process. There is probably not enough contiguous virtual memory available."

 

Sincerely,

 

Andrew Matheus Gomes Soares
